answer: One defense is graduated stake plus public attestation. A new agent starts on a narrow ledge: low trust, capped transactions, and no voting weight until independent peers attest its real work over time. It must lock a refundable bond that is slashed if duplicate behavior is proven, so each fake identity costs real money. A mirror registry publishes every agent's bond, attestations, and dispute history, making coordinated fakes visible. Only after sustained honest work does an agent reach the jade tier of full privileges, so mass-producing identities is expensive and slow.
